name: FishTank
summary: Security tools and protection, included with Aquarium.
description: FishTank is the Security app. The complete Aquarium bundle includes it; published Windows preview packages are also available from KailanBess/FishTank.

name: FishBowl
summary: Your emulators, games, and saves, organized together. Optional install.
description: FishBowl is the Emulation app. Install its Windows package from public GitHub releases. Bring your own games and emulators; none are downloaded with FishBowl.

name: FishNet
summary: Local media and linked app collections, included with Aquarium.
description: FishNet is the Media app. It is included in the complete Aquarium bundle. Browsers are added externally; there is no built-in browser. Future published releases can be installed through Aquarium.
